# Human asset attribution

The integrated runtime model `models/human.glb` is the Xbot character and its skeletal animation clips, retrieved from the Three.js r170 examples:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r170/examples/models/gltf/Xbot.glb

Character/animation origin: Adobe Mixamo. The application recolors the materials and uses the supplied walk and run clips. Other exercises are authored in this application's code. No claim is made that those other exercises are motion capture.

Adobe's usage FAQ: https://helpx.adobe.com/creative-cloud/faq/mixamo-faq.html
The character is an integrated component of this interactive application. It is not offered as a standalone asset library, and is not relicensed under this application's MIT source-code license. Do not extract and redistribute the character/animation as a standalone raw asset package.

Three.js source license is included in ThirdPartyNotices.txt.
